subject: Q4 renewal & benchmarking: bake-off request + capacity uplift
messages:
From: Caroline Lowe <caroline@novamart.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal benchmarking and capacity uplift

Hi Karthik,

We’re kicking off the renewal conversation for Novamart — contract expires end of Q4. Internally we have a vendor bake-off: one competitor is offering a combined price + on-prem option which is tempting. That said, our primary concerns are deterministic latency under peak and predictable scaling during promotional events.

Can Redwood run a benchmark against our peak workload (simulated traffic profile attached in the RFP) and show p95/p99 latency across a 30-minute soak? We’d also like to evaluate a short Dedicated-capacity ramp for Q4 (estimate: 2k concurrent real-time requests, avg seq len ~512 tokens).

Two asks to move forward:
- A test window (we’re aiming for July 20–27)
- A provisional commercial/term proposal you can commit to if bench results match the SLA targets

I’ve attached the RFP and the traffic profile. Please loop in the team who would run the bake-off and a CS lead to collect telemetry.

Best,
Caroline Lowe
Director, AI Platform
Novamart

Attachment: novamart-rfp-july2028.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Lowe <caroline@novamart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-15T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal benchmarking and capacity uplift

Hi Caroline — thanks for the clear ask and the RFP. We’re keen to run the bake-off and show where Redwood’s runtime advantages land against latency and throughput requirements.

High level proposal from our side:
1) Operational: schedule a 2-hour bake-off slot during your July 20–27 window and a 30-minute soak at peak traffic. Jonas (CS) will collect spans/metrics and confirm telemetry schema.
2) Capacity: offer a provisional Dedicated trial (30 days) sized for 2k concurrent requests with canary routing and a quick rollback plan.
3) Commercial: a provisional term extension letter plus a short bridge offer while benching completes — we can outline a limited-time credit if results meet the SLA targets.

Marissa & Jonas — can you confirm availability for the week of Jul 20 and the minimal access we need (SSO/service account + allowed endpoints)?

Caroline — I’ll draft a short mutual action plan and a provisional offer if you’re ok to proceed.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-15T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal benchmarking and capacity uplift

Karthik — noted. Caroline, quick checklist from ops to make the bake-off smooth:
- Service account with token scope to the test tenant (SSO if possible)
- Traffic capture point (we’ll need request/response samples and header schema)
- Peak traffic schedule (time zone and time window for the 30-min soak)

We can run the bench in our hosted sandbox or bring a dedicated pool into your cloud account if you prefer network-local runs. For fairness to the bake-off we recommend:
- 3 runs: baseline, peak soak, and a stress run (short)
- Metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, token throughput, error rate, GPU utilization, and tail KV-cache miss rate

I’ve attached our benchmark playbook and a template telemetry file to make integration quick.

Marissa Cole
AM, Redwood Inference
Attachment: benchmark-playbook-v2.docx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Lowe <caroline@novamart.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-16T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal benchmarking and capacity uplift

Caroline — thanks, we can take the lead on telemetry collection and the soak. A few technical clarifications before we lock times: 
- Do your requests use streaming responses or single-shot generation?
- Are there specific model families you want us to run (we can run both your current model and a Redwood-verified equivalent)?
- Will the traffic include tool-calling or function invocation patterns?

Suggested slot: Jul 22 14:00–16:00 PT for the bake-off, with the 30-minute peak soak at 15:00 PT. We’ll prepare a short runbook and collect logs + traces.

I’m attaching a bench template you can pre-fill with payload sizes and sequence distributions — helps us to match traffic precisely.

Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-bench-template.json
From: Caroline Lowe <caroline@novamart.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>; Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-17T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal benchmarking and capacity uplift

Thanks team — Jul 22 works for the slot. A couple of notes so expectations are aligned:
- Competitor has quoted a lower run-rate and an on-prem/colocated option. Price is material to procurement.
- Our SLA bar: p95 < 100ms and p99 < 200ms for the 30-minute soak at your proposed 2k concurrent sizing.
- We will run a short continuity test (30 mins) at the end of the month to validate sustained throughput.

Procurement asks that we have a provisional commercial commitment while the bake-off is scheduled (they prefer something in writing to avoid procurement gating other vendor discussions). Will your bridge offer include a time-limited credit and a published performance SLO we can reference in the term sheet?

Looking forward to the run.

Best,
Caroline

Attachment: novamart-rfp-july2028.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Lowe <caroline@novamart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-22T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q4 renewal & benchmarking: bake-off request + capacity uplift

Caroline — appreciate the candor and the SLA targets. Following our internal review and the CS runbook, here is a provisional bridge offer to keep Novamart’s runway intact while the bake-off and continuity test complete: 

Provisional bridge offer (valid 14 days):
- 30-day Dedicated trial sized for 2k concurrent (fully isolated pool) with canary routing and automatic fallback to hosted variants.
- Performance commitment for the trial window: p95 < 100ms, p99 < 200ms for the 30-minute soak. If we miss the target, Redwood will provide a pro-rated credit equal to 25% of the Dedicated capacity fee for that month.
- Commercial: 5% credit on the first 6 months if you convert to an annual Dedicated commitment within 30 days of trial completion.
- One month of complimentary migration support (onboarding & runbook automation).

Operational next steps:
1) Jonas will run the bake-off today (Jul 22) at 15:00 PT and share the telemetry within 24 hours.
2) If the trial meets SLOs, we’ll issue a provisional term extension letter and a DocuSign for the bridge offer.
3) Procurement sign-off: if you want a slightly stronger commercial concession we can discuss a targeted credit tied to outcome thresholds.

I’ve attached a short provisional offer PDF and the DocuSign link to sign the bridge letter if you’d like to lock the trial. This keeps procurement happy and lets us proceed without delaying the bake-off.

Thanks — we’ll post results ASAP.

—
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: novamart-provisional-offer-20280722.pdf
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/ZZZ-novamart-provisional
